verdict.rationale: Factory's Missions and Droid CLI workflows explicitly let a developer describe work in plain language and have it scoped into a defined task with milestones/success criteria before code is written (factory-docs-22), then delegate that scoped task for implementation (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-30, factory-docs-18). This directly matches the intent-to-spec story of turning plain language into a scoped implementation task. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating the quality and accuracy of the auto-scoping (all evidence is vendor documentation).
